sara_sales: Quick sync — AcmeCorp just signed a hybrid commit (reserved + burst). They gave us traffic: ~5M tokens/day baseline, but 50M tokens/day during marketing spikes (10x for ~10m windows). They also want VPC + KMS and answered 20/120 on our security questionnaire. What do we recommend for reserved GPUs and autoscale?

devin_se: Thanks. What model are they running? llama-3-70B or a smaller finetuned 13B? sequence length? concurrency patterns? :thinking: 

sara_sales: They plan to use an instruction-tuned 13B variant, avg seq len 256, p95 1024. Concurrency estimate: baseline 150 qps, spike 1500 qps for the 10m bursts. 

olga_sre: OK — for 13B at 256 tokens we usually see ~120 tps per A100-80GB with optimizations; p95 will drop. For baseline 150 qps that's ~1.3k tps (tokens per sec?) Wait we should translate: qps * avg tokens = tokens/sec. 150 qps * 256 tokens ~= 38.4k tokens/s baseline, spike 384k tokens/s. 

mike_infra: For reserved pool I'd propose 6 x A100-80GB (assuming ~6k tokens/sec per GPU steady with batching) + burst pool of 12 GPUs in a shared pool. That yields floor capacity and headroom. Also recommend AZ spread 3-way. :thumbsup: 

devin_se: Quick sanity check math: if a single A100 gives ~6k tok/s at 256 avg, baseline 38.4k/6k ~=6.4 -> 7 GPUs baseline. Spikes 384k/6k ~=64 -> we need 64 GPUs if we tried to serve all on dedicated. So mix reserved 8 GPUs + burst up to 60 seems more realistic. 

alex_security: From security side: VPC private control plane required, KMS integration ok, need HSM option for keys (they marked regulated). Also they've got a SOC2 scoping Q about network egress logging — we'll supply config snippet and sample CLA. 

sara_sales: Can we draft a simple autoscale policy and a prewarm plan for the 10m bursts? They want guaranteed latency under 300ms p95. 

olga_sre: Autoscale idea: keep reserved pool at 8 GPUs, burst target up to 64 using spot-friendly instances with hedged prewarm. Prewarm rule: if we detect a sustained increase of 15% qps over 2 minutes, prewarm N GPUs (n = ceil(increase / 6k)). Also use request hedging back to smaller model if not available. Example policy: 

```
{ "min_reserved":8, "max_total":64, "scale_up_policy": {"metric":"tokens_per_sec","window":"120s","threshold_pct":15}, "prewarm":true }
```

mike_infra: For cost/contracting let's propose reserved commit for 8 GPUs monthly, plus burst credits billed at usage. Pricing: reserved ~$7k/GPU mo, burst at $1.8/GPU-hr (example). We'll provide exact quote offline. 

sara_sales: Great — I'll update the security questionnaire answers and send the proposed commit: reserved 8 GPUs + burst pool to 64, autoscale + prewarm rules, VPC + KMS/HSM. Action items: Devin to validate perf numbers with perf-run, Olga to draft autoscale policy, Alex to finalize security Qs, Mike to produce pricing estimate. 

devin_se: I'll run a quick perf test today: `./tools/perf_run.sh --model 13B --concurrency 200 --seq 256 --duration 5m` and share logs. 

deploy-bot: perf-run job #4427 started by devin_se at 2062003478 — ETA 5m. 

sara_sales: Thanks team, will loop in legal for contract language. We'll try to have draft to AcmeCorp by EOD. :rocket:
